facts.text: The hotel was built as a 17th-century cloister and has significant heritage value.

facts.text: The hotel is within the walled city of Cartagena, Colombia.
facts.excerpt: Welcome the New Year from the heart of Cartagena's Walled City with an exclusive experience at Hotel Charleston Santa Teresa.

facts.text: Rooms and suites are spread across a 17th-century Colonial Convent and a Republican Building.
facts.excerpt: located in the Colonial Convent of the 17th Century and the Republican Building

facts.text: Rooms and suites are decorated in a colonial and republican style.

facts.text: The rooftop pool and solarium offer a 360-degree view taking in the red roofs of the old city, the skyscrapers of the modern city, the port and the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: 360° view of the entire city that integrates in a single panorama, the red roofs of the old city, the imposing skyscrapers of the modern city, the vibrant port of the city with its large cruise ships

facts.text: Santa Teresa Spa, on the hotel's second floor, offers massages, therapies, rituals, wet areas and a 24-hour gym.
facts.excerpt: Located on the second floor of the hotel, SANTA TERESA SPA, offers massages, therapies, rituals, wet areas and a 24-hour gym.

facts.text: Colonial Suites sit in the 17th-century Colonial Convent and preserve the details of the historic building, with views of the colonial facades and streets.

facts.text: Grand Suites in the Republican Building are one-bedroom suites with a living room and separate dining room, overlooking Plaza Santa Teresa, the walls, the Caribbean Sea and the modern city.
facts.excerpt: one-bedroom suites offer a comfortable bedroom, living room, and separate dining room with an impressive view over Plaza Santa Teresa, the iconic walls, the Caribbean Sea, and the modern city

facts.text: Premium Balcony rooms have an internal balcony overlooking the central Republican courtyard.
facts.excerpt: its internal balcony overlooking the central Republican courtyard

facts.text: Classic Ocean View rooms are on the 4th and 5th floors of the Republican Building, with views over the historic walls and the Caribbean Sea.

facts.text: Master Suites are on the top floor of the Republican Building, with living and dining areas overlooking the Caribbean Sea and the modern city.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive and luxurious suites on the top floor of the Republican Building, combining modern decor with historical architectural details. Relax in the living and dining areas overlooking the Caribbean Sea and modern city.

facts.text: Harry's Cartagena, by chef Harry Sasson, serves international cuisine with a fusion of Colombian flavors.
